# Version 4.155.0
> **M155 engine and interoperability** · [NuGet (prerelease)](https://www.nuget.org/packages/SkiaSharp/4.155.0-rc.1.26512.8)

> **API changes** · [SkiaSharp API diff](4.155.0/index.md) · [HarfBuzzSharp API diff](harfbuzzsharp/14.4.0/index.md)

## Highlights

SkiaSharp 4.155.0 advances to Skia m155 with servicing fixes and refreshed HarfBuzzSharp support. It also updates GLES interop for pointer-based platform calls and disables RAW and DNG decoding while retaining source and binary compatibility.

## Breaking Changes

*None in this preview line.*

## Engine

- **Skia updated to milestone M155** — Updates the bundled renderer to Chrome milestone M155 and incorporates later upstream fixes, including corrections for failed-flush cache entries and FontConfig family matching. ([#5081](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5081), [#5196](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5196), [#5286](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5286))

## API Surface

- **GLES platform interop uses explicit pointers** — GLES and WinUI EGL interop now use blittable pointer-based calls, with existing platform callers pinned explicitly instead of relying on managed array and string marshalling. ([#5155](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5155))
- **HarfBuzzSharp 14.4 OpenType tags exposed** — The HarfBuzzSharp update provides documented OpenType bit and number tag enums for usable native tag values without exposing raw native-shaped APIs. ([#5135](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5135))

## Bug Fixes

- **RAW and DNG decoding disabled** — The bundled decoder no longer accepts RAW or DNG images. The SKEncodedImageFormat.Dng value remains available for source and binary compatibility, but it does not indicate codec support. ([#5162](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5162))

## HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0

HarfBuzzSharp now ships with HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and adds documented OpenType bit and number tag enums while keeping raw native fetch helpers internal.

Release Candidate 1 incorporates the final M155 servicing fixes before the stable release.
